comparisonPolicy.commonSupport: Common399 and the same frozen 20 contracts
comparisonPolicy.boundary: B04 is a same-environment 26×26 baseline, not a same-domain 21×21 baseline

metricDefinitions.loadPolicy: Within / IID boundary / one-space-per-entry IID explicitly separated; unsupported cells make whole aggregate null; no dropping/renormalization. Chen core inherited, 480 exception cells sourced from official table. Macro30 exact get_key_pair_time formula, not arbitrary geometry proxy.

macroxuePolicy.extension: Right-pinky x=10,11,12.25 at row0 and x=10 at row1. Native30 geometry and arithmetic unchanged.
macroxuePolicy.tokenization: Shared locked highest-frequency source455 character readings. Not the full upstream char_info dictionary.
macroxuePolicy.primaryCorpus: New eight-scene daily prose; written before scoring, not fitted to candidates. Default site text retained as secondary technical sample.
macroxuePolicy.purePhoneticCaution: Colliding layouts still generate raw strokes; score excludes candidate selection. Must compare collision and CKT choice metrics separately.
macroxuePolicy.trainingUse: Daily hanzi score enters search objective/floor. Default text is post-evaluation sensitivity, not an unseen population validation.

metricDefinitions.fairCKTPolicy: All five sizes use native CKT for known keys. Host domain validity and collision-freedom are separate. v5 stays frozen; v5-S(tau) is an independently labelled selection-sensitivity profile, not a new human calibration.

ensembleV6.status: Scenario index, not human-calibrated universal speed

memoryAuditR2.formula: M = ordinary_displacement_links + retroflex_links + YW_nonidentity_links + AEO_carriers + nonidentity_final_links + initial_extra_routes + final_extra_routes
memoryAuditR2.scope: common399; normalized written tails with j/q/x/Y-u restored as v; er explicit; iu/ui/un retained
memoryAuditR2.policy: Each nonidentity mapping costs one. An ordinary displaced initial is already charged; no second default fee. A/E/O shared physical carrier counted once. Every additional key within a head/final costs one routing item. Optional aliases included only where authoritative source is supplied.

S2Completion.suffixRule: all collision-bucket members, fixed-width base5, freq-desc order; own tone-order auxiliary keys
